article.title: OPEC+ deepens output cut; Brent jumps to a fourteen-month high
article.text: OPEC and its allies agreed on Sunday to extend and deepen production cuts by a further 1.1 million barrels a day through the first half of next year, tightening a market that was already drawing down inventories. Brent crude settled at a fourteen-month high, and the Indian crude basket rose to eighty-nine dollars a barrel. India imports more than eighty per cent of the crude it consumes, so a sustained rise in the basket lifts realisations for domestic producers such as Oil and Natural Gas Corporation while raising the input bill for every fuel-consuming industry. Refiners face a two-sided move, with feedstock costs and product cracks both repricing. Traders said the cut had been partly anticipated and that positioning was already long ahead of the meeting.

shocks.label: Crude price
shocks.mechanism: A deeper OPEC+ output cut tightens physical supply and lifts the benchmark crude price India imports against

companies.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
companies.mechanism: Unhedged upstream realisation per barrel rises directly with the benchmark crude price, lifting revenue on flat production volumes
companies.rationale: Domestic upstream producer selling crude at import parity with no marketing arm to absorb the gain

companies.name: GAIL India
companies.mechanism: Energy complex repricing generally lifts sentiment and realisations across the hydrocarbon value chain
companies.rationale: Large company in the same sector as the affected producers, so sector exposure applies here too

companies.name: InterGlobe Aviation
companies.mechanism: Aviation turbine fuel is priced off crude and is roughly forty per cent of the airline's operating cost, so a sustained basket rise compresses spread per available seat kilometre
companies.rationale: Single-fleet low-cost carrier with fuel as its dominant unhedged operating input

companies.name: MRF
companies.mechanism: Synthetic rubber and carbon black are crude derivatives and together form the largest share of tyre raw-material cost, with replacement-market price hikes lagging by a quarter
companies.rationale: Tyre maker with crude-derived inputs and limited immediate pricing power
negative_channels: synthetic rubber and carbon black cost inflation
